# Alchemist Behavior

> Alchemist Behavior is the manifestation and mindset coaching brand of Amanda Ferrer, author of the book "Alchemist Behavior: A Guide to Becoming a Master Manifestor" and creator of the 3-Month Quantum Shift Program, a private 1:1 coaching program.

Amanda's approach to manifestation combines three parts: identity work (rewriting self-concept), nervous system regulation (making the next level feel safe) and aligned action.

## Book
- [Alchemist Behavior: A Guide to Becoming a Master Manifestor](https://www.alchemistbehavior.com/#book): 9 chapters, 55 pages, journal exercises, the scripting method and a 30-day manifestation plan. $22, signed copies available.

## Coaching
- [3-Month Quantum Shift Program](https://www.alchemistbehavior.com/#program): 12 weekly 1:1 calls, Voxer access, a custom 90-day manifestation plan, business and career consulting, and lifetime community access.
- [Book a discovery call](https://www.alchemistbehavior.com/intake.html)
